headline.zh: 长寿路上深夜营业的咖啡好去处
headline.en: Late-night coffee spot on Changshou Road

traits.zh: 营业至深夜，适合夜猫子
traits.en: Open until late, perfect for night owls

traits.zh: 室内有高脚凳和圆凳，室外设折叠椅桌
traits.en: High stools and round stools inside, folding chairs outside

focus.zh: 有高脚凳和圆凳，但未见办公设备

energy.zh: 店内装饰热闹，但未见拥挤

linger.zh: 提供多种座位选择，适合久坐
linger.en: Multiple seating options, good for lingering
